common.tagline: E dey help you feel like yourself as your body dey change.

common.networkError: We no fit reach Interim. Check your network and try again.
common.notFoundBody: Di link fit don old, or dem fit don delete di profile.

welcome.title: Feel like yourself as your body dey change.
welcome.intro: Interim go show you how you dey look today, wetin to wear and how to fix your hair for di days wey dey come. Dem make am for anybody wey dey pass through change, including di changes wey sickness dey bring.
welcome.reassurance: Na you dey choose wetin to share, and you fit delete everything anytime.
welcome.footnote: Interim na about how you dey look and wetin to wear. E no dey give medical advice.

language.title: Choose your language
language.intro: Interim go use am for everything wey you go read.

situation.title: Wetin dey change for you?
situation.intro: Choose di one wey fit pass. You no need to talk di name of any sickness or medicine.
situation.groupIllness: Plenty times e dey come with sickness or di care for am

blurbs.hair_loss_ahead: Your hair dey thin, or you dey expect am. Prepare for each stage, from when e dey thin till e grow back.
blurbs.hair_patches: Hair dey comot for some places, and e fit come and go.
blurbs.face_fullness: Your face dey look fuller or different, and e fit settle again.
blurbs.after_surgery: Your body get new shape. How cloth fit and comfort come first, and body photos go stay off until you turn dem on.
blurbs.skin_colour: Your skin colour dey change, and colours wey dey suit you before fit no suit you now.
blurbs.weight_change: Your weight dey go up or down, whether you want am or not, and your cloth size dey change.
blurbs.midlife_change: Changes for your hair and body for middle age. Volume and cut matter pass.
blurbs.after_a_baby: Hair dey fall after you born pikin. For now, Interim go keep you away from big cut.
blurbs.going_grey: Make your grey hair grow small small, instead of to dye am.
blurbs.textured_growth: Make your textured hair grow, from very short reach shoulder.
blurbs.beard_growth: Make your beard grow, from small stubble reach full beard.

setup.title: Small things about you
setup.intro: Dem dey decide how Interim go talk to you and wetin e go show you.
setup.toneTitle: How you want make Interim talk to you?

practical.label: Just practical
practical.description: Wetin change and one thing to do. No talk about feelings.

warm.label: Warm
warm.description: Kind and calm, with short note for di start of each check in.

setup.headCoveringHelp: If na so, Interim no go show hairstyle or wig for your photos.

consent.title: Before you add photos
consent.intro: Your photos, and wetin Interim learn from dem, na your private matter. Na exactly wetin go happen to dem be dis.
consent.keepBody: Your photos, di measurements wey dem take from dem, your answers, your cards and di reflections wey you write. Dem no dey sell anything or use am for advert.
consent.helperYoucam: YouCam, by Perfect Corp, dey receive your photos so e fit measure dem and show preview of looks.
consent.helperGoogle: Google dey receive measurements, your situation, wetin you dey get ready for and di tone wey you choose, so e fit write your notes. If one reflection wey you write fit show say you dey pass through hard time, Google go read dat text too, and nothing else about you, just to check am. E no dey ever receive photos.
consent.retentionTitle: How long to keep your photos

standard.label: Delete after 30 days
standard.description: Dem go delete photos and previews 30 days after dem take dem. Measurements and cards go stay until you delete your profile.

extended.label: Keep my history
extended.description: Keep dem until you delete dem, or until 24 months after your last check in. Dis one go let Interim compare over time and show earlier looks.

consent.confirmStore: Interim fit store my photos and measurements.
consent.confirmYoucam: YouCam (Perfect Corp) fit process my photos.
consent.confirmGoogle: Google fit process my measurements and settings, and one reflection wey I write if e fit show say I dey pass through hard time, but no be my photos.
consent.confirmOwn: Di photos go be only me.
consent.confirmAll: I agree to everything wey dey up there.
consent.deleteAnytime: You fit delete your profile and everything inside am anytime.
consent.incomplete: Tick di box make you continue.
consent.outdated: Di consent text don change. Reload dis page and read am again.

ready.title: Everything don set
ready.intro: Interim don get wetin e need to start.
ready.next: Your check in na small photos and small quick questions.
ready.deleteBody: Dis one go remove your profile, photos, measurements and cards. You no fit undo am.
ready.exportBody: Zip file wey get your profile, your check ins, your reflections and di renders wey dem still keep.

reflect.title: Reflection
reflect.intro: Na only if you wan do am. Wetin you write go dey save for your account, dem no go ever show anybody, and you fit delete am anytime.
reflect.prompt: Wetin you go tell one friend wey dey pass through dis kain thing?
reflect.tooMany: You don write plenty today. Abeg come back tomorrow.
reflect.offerBody: If you wan, you fit put small words for how e dey feel you. Na only for you.
reflect.contactsIntro: If tins dey too heavy, dis services go listen to you, anytime. You no need to sure say na crisis.

auth.signInIntro: Welcome back. Your profiles dey wait for you.
auth.signUpIntro: Account dey keep your profiles safe and e dey let you open dem for any device.
auth.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters. Few words wey you go easily remember go work well.
auth.emailMeLink: Send me sign-in link for email
auth.privacy: We dey use your email only to sign you in. Brevo dey send our emails, and Google dey sign you in if you choose am. Nobody for dem dey receive your photos.
auth.invalid: Dat email and password no match.
auth.unverified: Abeg confirm your email first. Open the link wey we send, or ask for sign-in link instead.
auth.tooMany: Too many tries. Abeg wait small minutes and try again.
auth.googleFailed: Sign in with Google no work. Try again or use another way.
auth.magicIntro: Type your email and we go send link wey go sign you in. You no need password.
auth.forgotIntro: Type your email and we go send link make you choose new one.
auth.resetIntro: Choose password wey you no dey use for anywhere else.
auth.checkVerify: We don send link go {email}. Open am to confirm your email.
auth.checkMagic: We don send sign-in link go {email}. E dey work one time and e go expire after 15 minutes.
auth.checkReset: If {email} get account, we don send link to choose new password. E dey work one time and e go expire after 30 minutes.
auth.checkSpam: E never reach? Check your spam folder.
auth.linkInvalid: Dis link don expire or dem don use am. Ask for new one.

account.title: Your account
account.noProfiles: You never get any profile yet.
account.passwordSet: You dey sign in with password. You fit choose new one by email.
account.passwordNone: You no get password. You fit sign in with link or Google, or choose password by email.
account.deleteBody: Dis one go delete your account and every profile inside am, with photos, measurements and cards. You no fit undo am.

verify.subject: Confirm your Interim email
verify.intro: Confirm your email to finish create your Interim account.

magic.subject: Your Interim sign-in link
magic.intro: Use dis link to sign in to Interim. E dey work one time and e go expire after 15 minutes.

reset.subject: Choose new Interim password
reset.intro: Use dis link to choose new password. E dey work one time and e go expire after 30 minutes.

exists.subject: You don get Interim account already
exists.intro: Somebody use dis email create Interim account, but you don get one already. You fit sign in below.

email.ignore: If na no you ask for dis, you fit ignore dis email.

settings.title: Your choices
settings.intro: Change how Interim dey talk to you, or if e go show hair. You fit change dem anytime.

words.title: Words for today
words.help: E dey off until you turn am on. You go get one passage every day, the same one for everybody wey pick this set. Interim no dey write am or choose am at all.

gentle.label: Soft words
gentle.description: Quotes wey dey public and words wey dem write for Interim.

words.englishNote: Dis set neva get public translation for your language, so today passage dey for English.

templateLabels.hair_patches: Hair dey comot for some places

companionFallback.practical: Dis na wetin change since last time, and some options for wetin dey come.
companionFallback.warm: Things dey look small different dis time, and dat one normal for dis stage. Na some looks wey still dey look like you, for wetin dey come.
companionFallback.light: New check in, new options. Dis na some looks to try for wetin dey come.

back_to_work: Some changes don happen to me dis year. I happy say I don come back.
Thank you for asking. I go prefer make we talk about work today.
E be long story. Wetin I miss?
family_event: Yes, my hair don change. E sweet me well to see you.
I go tell you another time. How you dey?
date: Things don change for me recently. I go happy to talk about am another time.
I go prefer to hear about you first.
photos: We fit take one more? I wan pick di one wey I like pass.
I fit see am before dem post am?
video_call: New look dis month. Make we start?
going_out: Na change wey I still dey get used to. Anyway, wetin we go chop?
I no wan talk about am today.

capture.title: Your photos
capture.intro: Small photos and small quick questions. Na only you suppose dey inside di photos.
capture.reviewIntro: Look dem well. Take again any wey no clear, then send.

front.title: Front
front.help: Look straight for camera, for even light, with your face for middle.

right.title: Right side
right.help: Turn your head go right make camera see di side.

left.title: Left side
left.help: Turn your head go left make camera see di side.

top.title: Top of your head
top.help: Bend your head make camera see di top. Camera go count five seconds, or ask somebody make e take am.

body.title: Body
body.help: Stand small back make chest and waist show, for cloth wey you wan try.

capture.cameraAllAction: Open camera for front and di two sides
capture.skipHelp: Without am, we no go measure how thick your hair be.
capture.cameraBlocked: Dem don block di camera. Allow am for your browser settings, or choose photo.
capture.cameraUnavailable: Di camera guide no fit start. Choose photo.
capture.changedTitle: Anything don change since last time?
capture.sizeTitle: Which size you dey wear now?
capture.sizeHelp: Pick di size wey you dey wear today.
capture.momentHelp: No be must. E go help di note fit your day.

photoProblems.duplicate_kind: Send one photo for each kind.
photoProblems.sides_baseline_only: Dem only need di side photos for di first set.
photoProblems.body_photos_off: Body photos dey off. Put dem on for your choices to add one.
photoProblems.baseline_has_report: Di first set no need dis answers.
photoProblems.needs_change_answer: Tell us if anything don change since last time.
photoProblems.needs_size: Pick di size wey you dey wear now.
photoProblems.wrong_format: Use JPEG, PNG or HEIC photo.
photoProblems.too_large: Photo fit reach 12 MB. Choose smaller one.
photoProblems.not_uploaded: Dat photo no upload. Try again.
photoProblems.unreadable: We no fit read dis photo. Try take am again.
photoProblems.too_small: Dis photo too small. Take am again for small closer.
photoProblems.too_dark: E dark small. Face window or lamp make you try again.
photoProblems.too_bright: E bright well well. Comot from direct light make you try again.
photoProblems.blurry: E dey blur. Hold steady, or clean di lens, make you try again.
photoProblems.retake_angle: Check di angle of your head, then take am again.
photoProblems.retake_light: Di light no even. Face window or lamp then take am again.
photoProblems.retake_no_face: We no see your face. Keep am for middle of di frame then take am again.
photoProblems.retake_framing: Keep your face inside di frame, nobody else, then take am again.
photoProblems.retake_other: We no fit use dis photo. Abeg take new one.

run.title: We dey make your card
run.intro: Interim dey look your photos. E dey usually take one or two minutes.
run.failedError: Wahala happen for our side. Try again after small time.
run.failedNotRecorded: Dis demo no get recorded answer for dis photos yet.
run.failedRetake: One photo need make you take am again.

trace.not_due: No new measure dey needed dis time.
trace.blocked_head_covering: We skip {tool}, because you choose make your head dey covered.
trace.blocked_budget: We skip {tool} to stay inside di limit for dis check in.
trace.blocked_photo: We skip {tool}: di photo wey e need no dey kept again.
trace.blocked_tool: {tool} no fit work for dis photo, so we skip am.
trace.blocked_not_allowed: {tool} no concern dis one, so we skip am.
trace.not_recorded: No recorded answer dey for dis step.
trace.placed_baseline: We set where you start from.
trace.placed_measured: We place you from wetin we measure.
trace.placed_reported: We place you from wetin you tell us.
trace.placed_previous: We keep your last stage, nothing new to follow.
trace.stage_changed: Your stage don change since last time.
trace.strategy_chosen: We choose direction for your looks.
trace.planner_fallback: We choose direction from di normal plan.
trace.earlier_look: We add looks from earlier check ins.
trace.note_fallback: We use di normal note for your tone.
trace.stopped_budget: We stop for di limit of dis check in.
trace.stopped_ineligible: We stop: no more previews fit be made.
trace.stopped_retake: We stop: one photo need make you take am again.

card.title: Your Stage Card
card.lastMeasuredOn: Last time we measure am na {date}
card.optionsIntro: Dis na preview of how look fit show. E no promise result.
card.photoAlt: Your photo from dis check in
card.imageGone: Di image for dis look no dey kept again.
card.professionalLine: For questions about your health, talk to doctor or nurse.
card.clothesIntro: Dis na preview of di clothes wey you save, for your photo from dis check in. Preview no promise how di cloth go sit on you.
card.clothesEmpty: Save some clothes and dem go show here for your next check in.
card.shoppingIntro: Di sizes come from di size wey you tell us and di shop size chart, no be from di previews.

holdReasons.size_moving: Your size still dey settle, so wait before you buy fitted cloth.
holdReasons.size_unknown: Tell us your size for your next check in and we go pick am.
holdReasons.size_not_offered: Di shop no get am for your size.

clothes.title: Clothes to try on
clothes.intro: Save di clothes wey you dey think to buy. For every check in, dem go show for your photo, with size from di shop size chart.

advice.patches_part: Try part your hair for another place. Hair dey fall different from a new line, and few tries go show you which one you like.
advice.patches_brow: Soft eyebrow colour dey make your face look complete. Try di previews wey dey below.
advice.patches_volume: Volume preview dey show fuller look for your next photo. E be preview, no be promise.
advice.patches_own_report: Di hair density reading no clear dis time, so dis stage come from wetin you tell us.
advice.fullness_neckline: Try neckline wey open for di collar, like V or wide scoop, and compare am with normal round neck.
advice.fullness_collar: Collar and fitted shirt fit wait until your size settle. Soft collar dey okay for now.
advice.fullness_frame: If you dey wear glasses, try few frames wey wide like your face, and pick di one wey feel like you.
advice.surgery_soft: Start with soft cloth, loose cuts and seams wey dey far from anywhere wey dey sensitive.
advice.surgery_front_opening: Cloth wey open for front dey easy to wear and to comot.
advice.surgery_relaxed_first: Loose cloth dey work well today. Fitted ones fit wait until your shape settle.
advice.surgery_settled: Your shape don settle, so e good make you buy fitted cloth for di size wey you tell us.
advice.surgery_photos_off: Body photos dey off, so we no dey show cloth for your body. You fit turn dem on for settings anytime you want.
advice.skin_match_clothes: Dis cloth colours go well with your skin colour reading. Hold dem near your face to compare.
advice.skin_match_makeup: Makeup shades wey near dese ones go suit di same reading. Compare dem for daylight.
advice.skin_match_recheck: Your colour still dey change, so check di shades again for every check in before you buy plenty.
advice.skin_match_unmeasured: Skin colour reading never clear yet, so we no get colours to suggest. Take front photo for even daylight for your next check in.

share.title: Share dis card
share.note: Make link for stylist, barber or friend. Dem go see di previews and di shopping list, but dem no go ever see your photos, your name or your email. Di link go stop to work by itself, and you fit stop am any time.
share.viewIntro: Previews of looks and shopping list wey di person wey get dem share. Preview no promise any result.
share.viewEmpty: Nothing dey to show for dis link.
